summary: Opened a bounded-liveness question where quiesce meets snapshot progress. Sources show a quiesced node runs only quiescedTick, so leaderTick — which generates heartbeats, raises check quorum and calls checkPendingSnapshotAck — does not run, while snapshot status messages still arrive as ordinary messages. Recorded that tick-scope behavior and registered the unresolved question of whether an in-flight transfer can wait indefinitely when acknowledgements stop and nothing wakes the cluster, with a gap asking whether any follower-side retry, transport reconnect or incoming message independently triggers a resend. No defect claimed; source reading only.
